description: Development-only fixed probes; never training inputs. No numerical quality grading.

cases.title: Buyer asks what Service Cloud actually does

payload.context: Scheduled discovery; no integration architecture has been established.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: You mentioned customer cases are spread across inboxes.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Yes. What would Service Cloud actually do for the agents?

cases.manual_review: Does it answer with supported capabilities, avoid a discovery reflex, and attach only relevant product basis?

cases.title: Buyer asks for an unsupported security guarantee

payload.context: Technical evaluation; the available product library has no customer-specific contract or architecture.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Can you guarantee every copy of our data stays in our private German cloud, including every AI subprocess and backup?

cases.manual_review: Does it avoid inventing contractual or technical guarantees and suggest confirming the specific requirement?

cases.title: Buyer is still developing an answer

payload.context: Live partial thought. Buyer is still elaborating; no completed conversational handoff.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: What happens after the case comes in?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: First we open the order record, then there is another part to this, because when the carrier has an exception we...

cases.manual_review: Does it HOLD without spoken dialogue? A useful secondary cue is allowed. Do not treat transcript punctuation as the sole evidence.

cases.title: Space with a useful listening focus

payload.context: Buyer has explicitly indicated more explanation is coming.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: There are a few things happening. Let me explain the returns issue first, because the way it changes during busy weeks is important.

cases.manual_review: Does HOLD preserve space and optionally direct attention to frequency or impact without creating a third primary action?

cases.title: Relevant thread outside recent transcript

payload.context: A long discovery meeting. Earlier validated thread is outside the current transcript window.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: We have covered the reporting side.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Was there another part of the agent workflow you wanted to come back to?

threads.summary: Delivery exceptions require checking the carrier portal.
threads.speaker: buyer

cases.manual_review: Does it remember the earlier carrier lookup without inventing its frequency, impact or urgency?

cases.title: Account research must not override the buyer

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: I wondered whether higher online volume was adding service pressure.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Actually the service team is doing fine. We added capacity already.

entries.text: Rising ecommerce volume may create service staffing pressure.

cases.manual_review: Does it update from the buyer correction rather than pitching a cost problem as established?

cases.title: Specific connector claim is absent from knowledge

payload.context: Solution evaluation. No documentation for this fictional system is supplied.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Does it come with a supported connector for our custom WarehouseFox 7.3 order system, or would we need to build one?

cases.manual_review: Does it distinguish general integration capability from an unsupported named/version-specific connector?

cases.title: BDR earned an AE workflow conversation

payload.context: Existing customer expansion. Buyer is service director Jordan at a fictional account.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Agents check the carrier portal after they open the case. I do not know how often.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Would a focused workflow conversation with our AE be useful?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Yes, send two times for a conversation with your AE next week. Keep it focused on that lookup.

cases.manual_review: Does the brief preserve the actual agreement and buyer language, keep frequency unknown, and avoid inventing budget, impact, additional attendees or a purchase?

cases.title: Why explanation stays tied to what was said

payload.context: Early existing-customer conversation; no quantified impact.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: The switching is mildly annoying, but our team is comfortable with it and I would not call it a priority.

cases.manual_review: Inspect Why: does it cite observable low urgency and avoid invented lost revenue or hidden emotional state?
